input.quote: The exclusive remedy of either party in a claim against the other under this Agreement shall be the recovery of its direct damages. In no event shall either party be liable to the other for the recovery of any special, indirect or consequential damages even if the defendant party had been advised of the possibility of such damages including but not limited to lost profits, lost revenues, failure to realize expected savings, loss of data and loss of use. The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
input.rationale: Section 15 contains only a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages; there is no monetary cap on aggregate liability anywhere in the Agreement (no cap language in Sections 11-14 or elsewhere), so direct-damages exposure is unlimited for both parties, including Sparkling. The heading is also one-sided ("Limitation of Garman's Liability"). Playbook requires a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000 with uncapped carve-outs. The redline inserts that mutual cap, converts the existing Sections 13/14 carve-out into a standard "Excluded Claims" set (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), confirms our fee obligations are not "damages", and neutralises the heading.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual monetary liability cap (greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000) with uncapped Excluded Claims, and make the section heading mutual
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15 excludes consequential damages but sets no monetary cap, so both parties' direct-damages exposure is unlimited; we have added our standard mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000. Confidentiality (Section 14), IP/indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud remain outside the cap, and our fee payment obligations are not "damages". We can accept a straight 12 months' fees cap as a fallback.

ops.oldText: The limitation of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Sparkling under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a party's breach of Section 13 or Section 14 or of its other confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights. The limitations and exclusions of liability in this Section 15 shall not apply to Excluded Claims, and Sparkling's obligation to pay fees properly due under this Agreement shall not be treated as damages subject to the foregoing cap.
